backCover.bio:
Jolie Lizana is a rare diesase patient, advocate, writer, and speaker. Her medical background gives her a two-point perspective, allowing her to help bridge gap between doctors and patients.

As the founder of Breathtaking Awareness, Jolie works to empower those living with pulmonary hypertension (PH), and other rare dieseases, through awareness, advocacy, education, and support.
